writeup: Woot has the new Rotary 15214 flat idler pulley, the replacement for Hustler 604491, at $5.99. It is a 2-inch OD, 3/8-inch bore composite flat idler used on Hustler Raptor pump setups, and the drop is limited to three per customer with three-plus left. The same Rotary 15214 is $13.99 in stock at Mr Mower Parts and $14.99 at Mow Town USA, so this is about $8.00 and 57 percent below the lowest verified street price.
